# Kelvarix

> We build the agents that run your business.

Kelvarix is an AI operations studio. We build and wire custom AI agents into
a business's existing tools, then hand over full ownership: no subscriptions,
no seats, no lock-in. Agents run on the client's own infrastructure and take
over busywork — lead follow-up, invoicing, WhatsApp support, call
transcription, reporting, competitor research, and more.

We also build one-time-cost custom products the client owns outright:
a conversion-optimised website rebuild, a CRM modelled to the client's own
data (not a generic tool), and custom MCP tools — e.g. a Telegram bot that
answers questions against a business's live stock, leads and numbers.

You handle business. We handle your workflows.

- Homepage: https://kelvarix.in/
- Contact: enquiry@kelvarix.in
- How it works: (1) 30-minute workflow call, (2) written blueprint with
  escalation rules and one measurable KPI, (3) agents live in weeks on the
  client's own infra, with handover.
- Pricing: fixed scope, quoted after a free mapping call. Reply within
  24 hours.

Keywords: convert your business to AI with Kelvarix, custom AI agents,
AI operations studio, own your CRM one-time cost, MCP Telegram stock.
